content: @Yunsong Yang 's PR to implement fancy update support in the Proof mode is now merged. :tada: This means one can use the imod and imodintro tactics for fancy updates for any BI which implements the BIFUpdate typeclass. In particular, one should now have all the ingredients to be able to define wp generically over an BI with BIFUpdate. It also lays the groundwork for tactics like iinv once invariants are actually implemented.
